_note: Cover letter templates. Edit them on Copilot > Cover letters. Placeholders: {role} {company} {hook} {name} {headline} {achievement} {current_company} {current_title} {date}. Replace every [bracketed] line with your own facts. The template whose 'match' words best fit the job title/description is picked automatically.
default_hook: What {company} is building is exactly the kind of problem I like to own end to end.

general.label: General
general.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the {role} role at {company}. {hook}

I'm {headline}. Most recently I {achievement}.

A few more results that map to what this role needs:

- [Result 1: what you did, and the number that moved]
- [Result 2: a skill from the job description, with proof]
- [Result 3: scope you owned, team size, or stakeholders]

I'd value the chance to show how I'd approach the work at {company}. Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
{name}

technical.label: Technical / Engineering
technical.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the {role} role at {company}. {hook}

I'm {headline}, and I like problems where scale and reliability are the product. At {current_company} I {achievement}.

- [System or feature you built, the stack, and the measurable outcome]
- [A performance, reliability or cost improvement with numbers]
- [How you work with product, design or other engineers]

I'd love to talk about the technical challenges your team is working on.

Best regards,
{name}

growth.label: Growth / Marketing
growth.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the {role} role at {company}. {hook}

My work is measured in funnel numbers. As {headline}, I {achievement}.

- [Experiment or campaign, and the lift it produced]
- [Channel or funnel stage you owned, before and after]
- [How you measure: tools, dashboards, attribution]

I'd be glad to share how I'd look at {company}'s funnel in my first 30 days.

Best regards,
{name}

startup.label: Startup / Founder's office / Generalist
startup.body:
Dear {company} team,

I'm applying for the {role} role. {hook}

I'm {headline} and I'm at my best when I own an outcome end to end with little structure around it. At {current_company} I {achievement}.

- [A 0-to-1 initiative you drove, and its result]
- [A time you worked across several teams without formal authority]
- [Analysis or a decision you made that changed direction]

I'd love to help {company} move faster on its most important priorities.

Best regards,
{name}

people.label: Sales / Customer / Account roles
people.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the {role} role at {company}. {hook}

I'm {headline}. Recently I {achievement}.

- [Quota, revenue or retention number you hit]
- [A difficult customer or deal you turned around]
- [The tools and process you use to stay organised]

I'd welcome a conversation about {company}'s customers and goals.

Best regards,
{name}

career_switch.label: Career switch
career_switch.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the {role} role at {company}. {hook}

I'm moving into this field from [previous field], and I bring skills that transfer directly. As {headline}, I {achievement}.

- [Transferable skill 1 with proof]
- [Course, project or certification relevant to this role]
- [Why this field, and why now]

I learn fast and would be glad to show what I can do for {company}.

Best regards,
{name}
